Aspera Connect — phone install (simple)
=======================================

BEST — Google Play Internal testing (marketing@thegstco.com)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
See docs/PLAY-STORE-INTERNAL.md
Employees install from Play Store. No USB. No Play Protect fight.

TODAY — sideload still works (no USB)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
On the PHONE browser:

  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ramchandragada/asperaconnect@cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/website/phone.html

Or PC Aspera Connect → Get phone app (no USB) → scan QR.

1. Download → allow Install unknown apps for Chrome once → Install
2. Soft Play Protect → Install anyway
3. Hard block (OK only) → use Play Internal testing instead of USB
4. App version should show v0.3.11

USB (IT emergency only): INSTALL-PHONE-USB.txt
